FULL TEXT:
PATNA HIGH COURT
NOTICE
District Judge (Entry Level), Direct from Bar Exam-2026
In view of several representations received from the candidates I aspirants of
District Judge (Entry Level), Direct from Bar Exam-2026 who have already applied I
registered online for the said exam during the period 16.04.2026 to 15.05.2026 which
was extended till 25.05.2026 in response to the Advertisement No. BSJS/1/2026 dated
30.03.2026, as decided, it is hereby informed that the online portal of the Patna High
Court shall be reopened only for them from 21.07.2026 to 28.07.2026 till 23:59 hours
for rectification of mistakes I errors I defects in online application forms and online
deposition of examination fee as well as for uploading the documents and the same will
remain available upto 30.07.2026 till 23:59 hours only for the purpose of uploading the
documents such as scanned photographs, declaration written in the hand writing of the
candidate, filling in bank reference number etc. and obtaining the printout of application
form.
Further, representations of the candidates I aspirants of District Judge (Entry
Level), Direct from Bar Exam-2026 regarding refund of examination fee paid by them
stand rejected in terms of the clause 10(b) mentioned at page 9 of the advertisement.
Helpline number as given in advertisement shall also remain available during the
office hours for the aforesaid period for assistance of the registered
candidates/aspirants.
The candidates are advised to keep visiting the website of the Court regularly for
further details I updates.
Patna High Court, Patna
Date: 17/07/2026
By order of the Court
Registrar General
